name: rynok

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix contracts run compile && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend && prettier --check .
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:cov: npm run test:cov:all -w backend && npm run test:cov -w frontend
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:browser

description: Marketplace inmobiliario descentralizado con escrow en Ethereum
